title: CS1-SB: constant-width collimation, backward decoding, and exact collective tests

claims.statement: For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, put n = ceil(log2 N). The single CS1-SB algorithm in proof.md recovers the whole secret with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies. On EVERY branch, including failures, retries, discards and aborts, total charged sequential work is O(n^3 (log2 n) 2^(2 sqrt n)). All four resource bounds and source tolerance hold jointly for this one configuration, with absolute outside constants. The exact growth index of the declared envelope is 1/2.

For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, put n = ceil(log2 N). The single CS1-SB algorithm in proof.md recovers the whole secret with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies. On EVERY branch, including failures, retries, discards and aborts, peak classical workspace is O(n^2 2^(sqrt n)). All four resource bounds and source tolerance hold jointly for this one configuration, with absolute outside constants. The exact growth index of the declared envelope is 1/2.

For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, put n = ceil(log2 N). The single CS1-SB algorithm in proof.md recovers the whole secret with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies. On EVERY branch, including failures, retries, discards and aborts, peak quantum workspace is O(n). All four resource bounds and source tolerance hold jointly for this one configuration, with absolute outside constants. The exact growth index of the declared envelope is 0.

For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, put n = ceil(log2 N). The single CS1-SB algorithm in proof.md recovers the whole secret with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies. On EVERY branch, including failures, retries, discards and aborts, fresh source acquisitions, including every discarded and rejected copy is O(n^(3/2) (log2 n) 2^(sqrt n)). All four resource bounds and source tolerance hold jointly for this one configuration, with absolute outside constants. The exact growth index of the declared envelope is 1/2.

The same CS1-SB configuration proves source tolerance epsilon(n)=0. Every acquired source copy must be an independent ideal coset state. Under this promise the full-secret success guarantee and all four resource bounds hold jointly. No positive malformed fraction is claimed.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
